title: The Ghost in the Router
tagline: A digital archivist confronts the colonial afterlife hidden in the algorithms of her own success.

story: Write a scene where a character discovers a direct digital link (like server routing) between their modern life and a historical colonial institution.
Create a monologue from the perspective of an elder who refuses to have their story recorded, explaining why memory must be embodied, not stored.
Draft a social media post from Zuri that she writes but ultimately deletes—one that is too messy, too real, and unfit for her curated brand.
Imagine a conversation between Baraka and the Lamu fisherman, meeting by chance, discussing what was taken from them and what remains.
technical: Build a simple web tool that visually maps the physical locations of data centers owned by major tech corporations onto historical maps of colonial trade routes.
Create a 'data dignity' license—a mock legal framework for a story that outlines terms for ethical use of personal cultural data and narrative.

cover_prompt: A young woman, a digital archivist, sits frozen at her glowing workstation, her face illuminated by cascading data streams that twist into spectral chains and colonial-era ledgers, her reflection a ghostly double in the dark screen, [Detailed Scene & Context: within a stark, minimalist server room where ethereal data-forms of stolen cultural artifacts—masks, textiles, oral histories—bleed from the central router like digital ectoplasm, wires snaking like roots across the floor], [Artistic Style & Medium: in the atmospheric, hauntingly detailed style of Remedios Varo and the digital collage aesthetic of Erik Johansson, blending surrealist precision with glitch art and photorealistic texture], [Composition & Camera: book cover framing, centered and intimate portrait composition with a slight low-angle looking up at the subject, dramatic tension between the human figure and the overwhelming digital haunting], [Lighting & Color Palette: dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with a cold, clinical blue-white core light from the monitors contrasting deep shadows and eerie, warm amber accents from the spectral data-forms, palette of desaturated blues, data-green, and corrupted gold], [Quality & Technical Enforcers: masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, intricate details, professional composition, sharp focus, 8k resolution, flux dev].
